messages:
Alex W: evening async check-in — what I did: rolled kv-evict patch to canary (sre-canary-3), validated warmup job, saw a small tail-latency blip (~0.6% p99 increase for 512 tokens). blocker: embedded-rate alerts started spiking from legacy clients; debounce needed. today: finish debounce PR, address CR comments, monitor canary and alerts.

Priya R: saw the alert stream. agree debounce is needed. propose: increase `for` to 2m and use `max_over_time` in rule to avoid transient spikes. example query: `max_over_time(sum(rate(api_errors_total[1m])) by (route)[2m:]) > 0` — happy to draft PR. :+1:

Mateo G: canary status — bumped to 20% traffic at 03:10 UTC. CPU/mem steady. KV eviction count up slightly during the ramp but no OOMs. running targeted p99 generator now to reproduce tail-latency, ETA ~25m.

Chen L: KV warmup note — deployed `prefill=true` to staging warmup job; initial metrics look good. snippet from staging logs:
```
prefill: started 2026-03-16T22:05Z
prefill: warmup_hits=10234 warmup_misses=24 p99_load=12ms
```
No obvious errors. also fixed a tiny typo in the rollback playbook link under /playbooks/kv-evict.

Sam K: quick CR ping on #4327 (kv-evict). Alex — can you add a unit test for the eviction boundary (size==threshold)? I added a branch `sre/kv-evict-tests` with a failing case. Will review after tests added.

oncall-bot: ALERT: 2026-03-16T22:20Z - high error rate detected for `dedicated/embeddings` (route=embed-batch). Routing to eng-sre oncall.

Alex W: @Priya R please open the Prometheus rule PR when you have a moment. @Sam K thanks — will wait for the test, then merge and watch. @Mateo G if p99 generator shows improvement, let's plan a slow ramp to prod later tonight. Can someone confirm rollback playbook is reachable from runbook UI? /playbooks/kv-evict

Priya R: on it, PR incoming in ~15m :thumbsup:

Mateo G: p99 run done — baseline improved by ~8% after warmup tweak. sending raw numbers to the thread.

Chen L: confirmed playbook link works from runbook UI; updated a minor header for clarity.

Sam K: pushed test to `sre/kv-evict-tests`, addressed the boundary case. @Alex W please merge when green.

Alex W: merging now, will keep an eye on alerts for the next 2 hours. thanks team :boat: 

(Short follow-ups will be posted here if alerts change or PR needs rollback)
